h2: NDT training near Tacoma: Clover Park’s NDT programme, shipyard and employer routes, and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Tacoma: Clover Park’s NDT programme, shipyard and employer routes, and online study compared

Tacoma has a full college NDT programme on its doorstep: Clover Park Technical College in neighbouring Lakewood teaches the six main methods at degree and certificate level. That changes the answer to "NDT school near me" for anyone in Pierce County. The other routes are the shipyard and employer paths that run through the South Sound, and online theory paired with a practical at work. Here is how they compare.

Who offers NDT training around Tacoma?

  • Clover Park Technical College, Lakewood. An Associate of Applied Technology or AAS-T degree in Nondestructive Testing of about eight quarters, with 95 technical credits covering visual and optical, magnetic particle, penetrant, radiographic, ultrasonic and eddy current testing, plus introductions to phased array and to digital detector and computed radiography. The college also lists method certificates in eddy current, MT and PT, radiography and ultrasonics, each about two to three quarters. It gives you lab time and a broad grounding; it does not certify you, because an employer does that.
  • Linn-Benton Community College, Albany, Oregon. A two-year AAS in Nondestructive Testing and Evaluation, a long way south down I-5 but a second college option for anyone willing to move.
  • Puget Sound Naval Shipyard, Bremerton. The shipyard runs a four-year apprentice programme with Olympic College that leads to an Associate in Technical Arts, and the college track is open to current shipyard and Keyport employees. The pages we found do not list the trades by name, so ask the shipyard whether a nondestructive test trade is open before planning around it.
  • Employers that train. Port, rail, fabrication and marine contractors around Commencement Bay hire helpers and build their hours under supervision. That route pays from day one and keeps the hours inside the written practice that will certify you.
  • ASNT Pacific Northwest Section. ASNT's section listings show it for Washington; meetings are a good way to meet working Level IIIs and hiring managers.

Which Tacoma route fits you?

You areUsually fitsKeep in mind
A newcomer who can study full timeA Clover Park degree or a single-method certificateQuarters of study before you start earning in NDT
A shipyard or port worker wanting an inspection roleYour employer's own route, with theory studied around shiftsNaval and defence work can carry customer requirements beyond a general course
A working technician adding Level II or a methodOnline theory plus the practical at your employerExperience hours are logged at work, not in a course
An employer qualifying a groupTraining run at your facility to your written practiceA Level III must prepare and grade the exams

Questions to ask before choosing a Tacoma-area provider

  1. Does each method's classroom time meet SNT-TC-1A's recommended hours for your level, and does the record say so? The hours planner lists the figures.
  2. Will the practical use welded plate, pipe or castings with real flaws, and who supervises it?
  3. Who certifies you once training ends? Under SNT-TC-1A, the employer; ASNT central certification is a separate exam route.
  4. Will the employer you want accept the hours under its written practice?
  5. Is an ASNT Level III available for questions while you study?

Where Atlantis fits for Tacoma candidates and employers

If Clover Park's quarter-based programme does not fit around your job, the Atlantis route is the alternative. Theory runs on the Atlantis portal at your own pace from the day you enrol, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, and set-ups can be rehearsed in the Practical NDT simulator. The hands-on practical and practical exam take place at your employer, on its equipment, under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and the employer certifies. Waterfront and fabrication work here leans on ultrasonic testing training and magnetic particle testing training; test yourself with the free practice tests and check where you stand with the SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker.

South Sound employers can bring training on-site for a crew through SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. Weld inspectors can look at AWS CWI exam preparation in Seattle, a six-day course. Nearby pages: Seattle, Portland and Washington.
